id: 02_How to flush an eyewash station Demonstration at ATRB
title: 洗眼器的定期冲洗
source_doc: course/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/02_How to flush an eyewash station Demonstration at ATRB.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/02_How to flush an eyewash station Demonstration at ATRB/src.py

points.K1: 洗眼器要定期放水冲洗
points.K2: 嵌墙式洗眼柜：先备引流装置

shots.scene: 欣欣站在走廊墙边的嵌墙式洗眼柜旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a recessed stainless steel eyewash cabinet in a corridor wall and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天看看洗眼器怎样定期冲洗。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着T恤短裤，提着蓝色水桶走到柜前
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a T-shirt and shorts walks up to the wall cabinet carrying a blue plastic water can with a black hose.
shots.narration: 今天轮到阿杰给洗眼柜放水。

shots.section_title: 洗眼器要定期放水冲洗
shots.scene: 嵌墙柜：左边灭火器箱，右边洗眼柜，上方有标识
shots.prompt_en: A recessed stainless steel wall cabinet with a fire extinguisher compartment on the left and an eyewash cabinet on the right, an eyewash sign and a safety shower sign above it. No people.
shots.narration: 这是嵌在墙里的喷淋洗眼柜。
overlay: 洗眼器要定期放水冲洗

shots.section_title: 洗眼器要定期放水冲洗
shots.scene: 柜门把手上挂着一张空白检查卡
shots.prompt_en: A close view of a blank inspection tag hanging on the handle of the stainless steel eyewash cabinet door. No people.
shots.narration: 柜门挂着检查卡，要定期放水。

shots.section_title: 嵌墙式洗眼柜：先备引流装置
shots.scene: 柜体底部的小排水口特写，下面没有接水盆
shots.prompt_en: A close view of a small drain outlet at the bottom panel of the recessed cabinet, with no basin below it, only the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 柜子底下只有排水口，没有水盆。
overlay: 嵌墙式洗眼柜：先备引流装置

shots.section_title: 嵌墙式洗眼柜：先备引流装置
shots.scene: 地面上的蓝色水桶，桶口接着黑色波纹软管
shots.prompt_en: A blue plastic water can on the floor with a black corrugated hose connected to its opening, ending in a rubber coupling. No people.
shots.narration: 所以要先做一套引流装置。

shots.section_title: 嵌墙式洗眼柜：先备引流装置
shots.scene: 软管、柔性接头和水桶三个部件，箭头连成一套
shots.prompt_en: Three parts linked by arrows into one setup: a black corrugated hose, a short rubber flexible coupling and a blue plastic water can. No people.
shots.narration: 引流软管、柔性接头，加一只水桶。

shots.section_title: 嵌墙式洗眼柜：先备引流装置
shots.scene: 水桶贴着一张只有洗眼器图标的标签
shots.prompt_en: A blue plastic water can with a blank label showing only an eyewash pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 水桶标明：洗眼器冲洗专用。

shots.scene: 螺丝刀、引流装置和一叠纸巾三张图标卡
shots.prompt_en: Three icon cards side by side: a flathead screwdriver, the hose-and-can drainage setup and a stack of paper towels. No people.
shots.narration: 准备一字螺丝刀、引流装置和纸巾。

shots.scene: 阿杰蹲下，把柔性接头套在排水口上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a T-shirt and shorts crouches and fits a rubber flexible coupling onto the drain outlet of the cabinet.
shots.narration: 把柔性接头套在排水口上。

shots.scene: 螺丝刀拧紧接头上的卡箍特写
shots.prompt_en: A close view of a flathead screwdriver tightening the metal hose clamp on the rubber coupling. No people.
shots.narration: 用螺丝刀把卡箍拧紧。

shots.scene: 软管另一头垂下，插进水桶口
shots.prompt_en: The black hose hangs down from the drain and its other end goes into the opening of the blue water can on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 软管另一头接进水桶。

shots.scene: 水桶平放在柜前地面，旁边放着纸巾和螺丝刀
shots.prompt_en: The blue water can stands steady on the floor in front of the cabinet, with paper towels and a screwdriver beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 水桶放稳，纸巾放在旁边备用。

shots.scene: 阿杰伸手到柜体右上方，拉开洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches up to the upper right of the eyewash cabinet and pulls it open to start the water.
shots.narration: 启动洗眼器，开始放水。

shots.scene: 水沿软管流进水桶的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram with blue arrows showing water flowing from the cabinet drain through the hose into the can. No people.
shots.narration: 水经排水口和软管，流进水桶。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在桶旁搓搓手，耐心等着
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands beside the can, rubbing his hands together and waiting.
shots.narration: 放一会儿水，让管路里的水流出来。

shots.scene: 接头、软管和水桶的固定画面，旁边沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: A still view of the coupling, the hose and the blue can, with an hourglass icon floating beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 关水后，再等上几分钟。

shots.scene: 软管里的水滴越来越少的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of the hose with fewer and fewer water drops falling into the can. No people.
shots.narration: 让水完全排净，再拆装置。

shots.scene: 阿杰蹲下，用纸巾托在接头下方，慢慢拆下接头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student crouches, holds a paper towel under the coupling and slowly removes it from the drain.
shots.narration: 拆接头时，用纸巾接住滴水。

shots.scene: 排水口面板上贴着滑倒警示标志
shots.prompt_en: A slip hazard warning sign on the small panel around the drain outlet. No people.
shots.narration: 面板上提醒：小心滑倒。

shots.scene: 阿杰用纸巾擦干地面上洒出的水
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wipes spilled water off the floor with paper towels.
shots.narration: 洒出来的水，全部擦干。

shots.scene: 阿杰提着水桶走到实验室水槽边
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries the blue water can to a lab sink.
shots.narration: 把水桶提到水槽边。

shots.scene: 水从水桶经软管倒进水槽
shots.prompt_en: Water pours from the tilted can through the hose into a lab sink. No people.
shots.narration: 把桶里的水倒进水槽，就完成了。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现软管、水桶和螺丝刀图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a hose, a water can and a screwdriver.
shots.narration: 接好引流，拧紧卡箍，启动放水。

shots.scene: 沙漏、纸巾和水槽三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: an hourglass, paper towels and a lab sink. No people.
shots.narration: 等水排净，擦干地面，倒进水槽。

shots.scene: 欣欣在洗眼柜旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the clean recessed eyewash cabinet.
shots.narration: 洗眼器常冲洗，用时才靠得住！
